system.description: Draws Essence from an external source and channels it into the thaumaturge or a willing recipient. Source may be deep Wyld, a demesne, a 3+ dot artifact, a spirit, a human sacrifice, or an Exalt. Success grants a mortal an Essence pool. Failure: five dice aggravated damage (plus debility if Willpower roll fails). Botch: eight dice aggravated damage plus a certain deformity. Exalted thaumaturge can be her own source, subtracting permanent Essence from difficulty.
